_losses: rc (XYZ MSE in global-pelvis repr: joint 0 = global pelvis, joints 1-16 = pelvis-relative) + vel×5 (velocity MSE: pelvis vel = global, other joints = relative-to-pelvis vel, good gait signal). lambda_rr must stay 0: joints 1-16 are already pelvis-relative, so the rr loss would subtract global_pelvis from relative coords producing a meaningless quantity. lambda_vel=5 gives vel gradient ~2-3x stronger than rc gradient, preventing mean-pose collapse.
